about.heading: Quality is a habit I practise from requirement to release.
paragraphs: I work across the whole testing lifecycle. I read requirements critically, turn acceptance criteria into traceable test plans, and then test the product the way real users will. That means manual, automated, API and performance testing, and each one has its own job in the release.
My day-to-day toolkit is Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, Postman and JMeter. I script in Java, Python and JavaScript, and I am comfortable inside Agile sprints, Jenkins pipelines and Jira workflows.
Developers like working with me because my bug reports are clear, reproducible and prioritised, and because I stay calm when a release is close.

highlights.title: Shift-left mindset
highlights.description: I question requirements and acceptance criteria before any code is written.

highlights.title: Full-stack coverage
highlights.description: I test the UI, the APIs, the data integrity behind them and how the system behaves under load.

highlights.title: Automation-ready
highlights.description: I spot stable, repeatable flows and turn them into scripts that run every time.

highlights.title: Clear defect trails
highlights.description: Each bug I file has steps, evidence, severity and the requirement it breaks.

projects.title: PeopleDesk
projects.summary: An HR platform on web and mobile. It covers employee records, attendance, leave and payroll, with workflows configured for each client.
projects.challenge: Every client ran its own configuration, so the same leave or payroll rule could behave differently from one tenant to the next.
projects.approach: I mapped test scenarios to each client's configuration, checked payroll and attendance calculations end to end, and kept a regression suite running across web and mobile builds.

projects.title: Managerium ERP
projects.summary: A single ERP that brings finance, HR, inventory, sales, procurement and admin into one system.
projects.challenge: The modules share data, so a change in procurement can quietly break inventory or finance further down the line.
projects.approach: I wrote integration test flows across module boundaries, checked API responses and status codes, and ran load tests on the heaviest transactional endpoints.

projects.title: Meena Game 2
projects.summary: A full 3D game built around Meena, UNICEF's much-loved South Asian cartoon character. It ships on mobile and web.
projects.challenge: A young audience on a wide range of devices meant gameplay, performance and UI had to work on low-end hardware.
projects.approach: I tested gameplay flows, device-specific performance and UI/UX on mobile and web builds, and fed clear, reproducible defects back into each sprint.

projects.title: Commplify
projects.summary: A virtual voice agent driven by AI that automates customer conversations.
projects.approach: I validated conversation flows, the APIs behind them and how the agent responded to edge-case input.

projects.title: Cloud Couture
projects.summary: An AI design studio that lets garment designers create new pieces and connect straight to suppliers.
projects.approach: I tested the designer-to-supplier workflow end to end, including generation, listings and the handoffs between them.

projects.title: WeFi
projects.summary: One platform for listing, finding and renting property.
projects.approach: I covered the listing and rental journeys, search and filtering, and the data consistency behind each listing.

projects.title: User API Testing · Newman
projects.summary: A Postman collection that runs headless through Newman and produces readable HTML reports for API regression.

projects.title: OrangeHRM Automation
projects.summary: UI automation for the OrangeHRM demo, built around a page-object structure so the suite stays maintainable.

projects.title: BDD with Cucumber
projects.summary: Acceptance scenarios in Gherkin, backed by step definitions that both business and engineering can read.

projects.title: API Load Testing · JMeter
projects.summary: Load and stress test plans that profile how APIs respond under rising concurrent traffic.

projects.title: Automation with JUnit
projects.summary: A structured JUnit suite that shows assertions, test lifecycle hooks and readable test design.
